# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `campfire` MCP server pointing at `https://api.meetcampfire.com/mcp`.
- Auth uses OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration against `api.meetcampfire.com` — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Campfire's official mark, from `campfire.ai`.
